caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic pitcher shaped like an owl, rendered in shades of green, gray, and light blue with some subtle hints of purple and pink on the rim and handle. The owl is shown in profile, sitting upright with detailed feathers covering its body, wings folded close, prominent round eyes, and defined talons. The handle of the pitcher is shaped like a branch and attaches to the back of the owl; the top of the handle features a small flower with pink petals and a yellow center. The open top of the pitcher forms the head of the owl, with the spout curving outward from the forehead area. The drawing is centered on a cream-colored background, bordered by a thin rectangular outline.
title: Owl Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
